params.body:
## What was off

On "Mijn aangeboden wagens" the state label is a tinted box with its own padding, so its text stood 8px to the right of the column head above it and of the term below it ("termijn voorbij", "nog 3 dagen"): three left edges in one column.

## What changes

`resources/css/ui.css`: the label is pulled left by its own padding, so its text, the column head and the term share one edge; the tint extends into the row's margin. On the phone card, where label and term sit side by side, the label keeps its normal place.

## Checked

Measured locally at 1440 on demo data: head, label text and term all start at the same x on every row (20 rows). Looked at the screenshot. Not rerun: the test suite (a two-line CSS change; `StylesheetSyntaxTest` and the ratchets run in CI).
params.title: Offered cars: state label, column head and term share one left edge
